Sara L: Heads-up — quick agenda pivot. CEO Q&A moving up 10 mins; need to swap slides/start earlier. Also saw OBS briefly go to black. Can someone take the handoff and confirm recording fallback? /cc @Kevin (AV) :eyes:
Kevin (AV): On it. I'll take OBS. If we hit black screen again, switch to 'Fallback Recorder' scene and start local OBS recording. I've pasted the quick switch steps below.
Kevin (AV): ```
1) Scene: Fallback Recorder
2) Source: HDMI-Backup
3) Start Recording -> Ctrl+Shift+R
4) Notify: #all-hands with `Recording started - local`
```
Jamie: Slides are queued on Slide Deck A. @Sara L do you want the CEO slides first or the roadmap? Also audio levels were a bit low earlier.
Sara L: CEO first, then roadmap. Audio: Alex can you bump the master +3dB? :pray:
Alex - Eng: I can do +3dB and monitor. Saw this in the OBS log: `warning: encoder overload` — switching encoder preset to "faster" now.
deploy-bot: Recording Service: detected dropped frames at 2026-03-23T15:12:07Z. Auto-fallback ready.
Maria (Events): If we go local record, someone needs to upload to S3 after. I have the upload checklist and can handle the upload + metadata tags.
Kevin (AV): Confirming: switched to 'Fallback Recorder' and started local recording. File: allhands_1861234567_local.mp4. Notifying execs. :thumbsup:
Sara L: Thanks Kevin. Jamie please cue CEO slides at T+2. Alex keep an eye on levels. Maria please stand by for upload.
Jamie: Cue acknowledged. 2-min countdown to slide handoff. :timer_clock:
Alex - Eng: Encoder preset switched, levels +3dB, no more overloads so far. Monitoring.
Sara L: OK team — CEO will take the mic in 30s. Quick note: we'll collect top 3 questions after the talk for leadership Q&A. Post them in this thread with :one:, :two:, :three:.
Lina P: :one: For CEO — what's the timeline & commitment model for Private deployments in EMEA? :question:
Sara L: Great Q — we'll surface that in the Q&A. Maria, once the local file finishes, can you upload and add tags: [all-hands, 2026-03-23, ceo-qna]?
Maria (Events): Yep — I'll upload and add tags, and ping infra for the retention policy.
Kevin (AV): Recording completed and file uploaded to staging S3 path: s3://redwood-recordings/staging/allhands_1861234567_local.mp4. Posting final status in #all-hands.
Sara L: Perfect. Thanks everyone for the quick pivot. If anyone sees frame drops again, drop a one-line note here and we'll swap to the backup stream. :wave:
